description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure at all. It is the standard "Check for updates" publisher badge (a Crossref/publisher similarity-check watermark) rendered on a light grey gradient background: a circular icon composed of an open yellow-gold ring with blue segments at the upper-left and right, enclosing a solid red bookmark/ribbon shape, with the two-line caption text "Check for updates" printed in dark grey sans-serif lettering beneath the icon. The image contains no axes, no units, no scale bar, no legend, no sample or alloy label, no data points and no micrograph. Because the router delivered it as an unclassified figure group for the paper "Microstructure and mechanical properties of a Fe–28Mn–9Al-1.2C-(0, 3, 6, 9)Cr austenitic low-density steel", it can be stated only that the figure element associated with this image carries no microstructure, diffraction, spectroscopy or mechanical-property evidence for the Fe–28Mn–9Al–1.2C–xCr (x = 0, 3, 6, 9) strips; no panel inventory can be built, no trend can be read and no scientific argument can be attached to it. Either the real figure was lost during PDF/image extraction (only the watermark tile survived) or the crop captured the badge in place of the figure content.
